## Keywords

{{< glossary system-requirements compatibility bottleneck specifications graphics-settings >}}

## 6.1 System requirements

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A store page lists the system requirements of a game.
- At the minimum, the game runs, but at low settings.
- At the recommended level, the game runs well at normal settings.
- **Do it:** Open the store page of a game you play. Which OS version does it require?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/requirements.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · Requirements

The facts: Neon Drift needs 8 GB of RAM at the minimum and recommends 16 GB. The recommended storage is 20 GB free on an SSD.

a) A PC meets only the minimum. How does the game run?
b) How much RAM does Neon Drift recommend?
c) Where does Google Play show the Android version that a game needs?

::: {.answer}
a) at low settings
b) 16 GB
c) in About this game, at Requires Android
:::

## 6.2 Comparing line by line

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Each line of the spec sheet is compared with the same line of the requirements.
- Each line is below minimum, at the minimum or at the recommended level.
- The weakest line decides the level of the whole device.
- **Do it:** In Spec Check, enter the lab computer. Which line is the weakest?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/compare-lines.png)
:::
::::

## Example · Laptop L1

Laptop L1 has Windows 11, 8 cores at 4.4 GHz, 16 GB of RAM, a GPU inside the processor with 2 GB and an SSD with 120 GB free.
**Which level does it reach for Neon Drift?**

::: {.reveal}
1. The OS, the processor, the memory and the storage reach the recommended level.
2. The graphics line meets only the minimum, because a graphics card with 6 GB is recommended.
3. The weakest line decides, so Laptop L1 reaches the **minimum**.
:::

## Try it 2 · The weakest line

The facts: Old PC O1 has Windows 10, 4 cores at 3.0 GHz, 4 GB of RAM, a graphics card with 2 GB and 60 GB free. Neon Drift needs at least 8 GB of RAM.

a) Which level does Old PC O1 reach?
b) Which line holds Old PC O1 back?
c) A laptop has 12 GB of RAM. Which level does its memory line reach?

::: {.answer}
a) below minimum
b) the memory (4 GB)
c) the minimum
:::

## 6.3 What holds the game back?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A compatibility problem stops the install, for example an old OS or too little free storage.
- A performance problem lets the game run slowly because of one weak part.
- The weakest part is the bottleneck, and the player lowers the setting that loads it.
- **Do it:** Compare your phone's OS version and free storage with your game. Can you install it?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/two-problems.png)
:::
::::

## Example · Three test phones

Neon Drift Mobile needs Android 10, 4 cores, 4 GB of RAM and 4 GB free. It recommends Android 12, 8 cores and 6 GB of RAM.
**What happens on phones P1, P3 and P4?**

::: {.reveal}
1. Phone P1 has Android 14, 8 cores, 8 GB and 40 GB free, so it reaches the **recommended** level.
2. Phone P3 has Android 9, so it has a **compatibility problem** and cannot install the game.
3. Phone P4 has only 4 GB of RAM, so the game runs at lower settings, and the RAM is the bottleneck.
:::

## Try it 3 · Which problem?

a) A phone has Android 9, and the game needs Android 10. Which kind of problem is it?
b) The game runs at 25 fps because the GPU is weak. What should the player lower first?
c) The game stutters with high textures. Which setting helps?

::: {.answer}
a) a compatibility problem
b) the resolution and the shadows
c) a lower texture quality
:::

## Try it 4 · Sort the devices (harder)

The facts: Desktop D1 has 6 cores at 4.0 GHz, 16 GB of RAM and a graphics card with 8 GB. Laptop L1 has a GPU inside the processor with 2 GB. Old PC O1 has 4 GB of RAM.

a) Which computer reaches the recommended level?
b) Which computer reaches only the minimum, and why?
c) What would bring Old PC O1 to the minimum?

::: {.answer}
a) Desktop D1
b) Laptop L1, because of its graphics
c) at least 8 GB of RAM
:::

## Summary

- System requirements list a minimum level and a recommended level.
- A device is compared line by line, and its weakest line decides its level.
- A compatibility problem stops the install, for example an old OS.
- A performance problem has a bottleneck that limits the whole device.
- The player lowers the setting that loads the bottleneck.
